source.author: verg
source.text_english: What sort of people is this?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Et primo quidem, antequam de fide mea, quam optime nosti, tecum loquar, aduersus barbariam istius loci uersu cogor clamare uulgato: quod genus hoc hominum?
reuse.text_original: Et primo quidem, antequam de fide mea, quam optime nosti, tecum loquar, aduersus barbariam istius loci uersu cogor clamare uulgato: quod genus hoc hominum?
reuse.text_english: And first, before I speak with you about my faith, which you know perfectly well, I am compelled to cry out, turning a line commonly uttered against the barbarism of this place: What kind of people is this?
